title: Online Retail
creator: Daqing Chen
citation: Chen, D. (2015). Online Retail [Dataset]. UCI Machine Learning Repository. https://doi.org/10.24432/C5BW33.
selection: All rows for invoice numbers 536365 through 536374, selected by invoice ID after scanning the complete workbook.
